騰輝電子-KY 產品主要分一般材         騰輝電子-KY 主要從事印刷電路板所需之黏合片、銅箔基板及鋁基板生產與銷
料與特殊材料                   售，一般材料產品應用於光電板、汽車板等中低階產品，特殊材料主要為散熱
                         鋁基板，另外亦有著墨軍工航天等利基型領域，2025 年產品組合：一般材料
                         41%、特殊材料 53%、其他 6%；2026 年一般材料受惠漲價、缺貨，預估 2026
                         年產品組合：一般材料 53%、特殊材料 41%、其他 6%。騰輝總部位於中國蘇
                         州，主要生產基地位亦位於中國蘇州(月產能 80 萬張)、江陰(月產能 20 萬張)、
                         深圳(月產能 10 萬張)與台灣(月產能 10 萬張)，泰國廠(月產能 10 萬張)則於 2026
                         年 9 月開始量產。

漲價不斷，2H26 獲利將持續跳升        騰輝 2H26 營運動能持續增溫，主要受惠 CCL 缺貨，不斷漲價，獲利預期出現
                         跳升。CCL 上游原料方面，E 布維持逐月漲價，而銅箔供給緊張程度僅次於玻
                         纖布；CCL 方面，CCL 龍頭廠商將產能集中於 M6 以上高速材料，中低階 CCL
                         供給明顯收縮，M6 以下、無鉛、無鹵素及高 TG 等一般材料訂單外溢至騰輝，
                         騰輝 2026 年一般材料價格 YTD+50%，一般材料已貢獻公司獲利超過一半，9
                         月份一般材料再續漲 10~15%；且一般材料產品組合持續轉佳，8 月份起單價與
                         獲利率較佳之高 TG 產品出貨量成長超過一倍，基本上目前公司所有產品線毛利
                         率皆達 30%以上，至於特殊材料仍穩定貢獻；綜上所述，預估 3Q26/4Q26 毛利
                         率將分別提升至 39.8%/41.6%，推估 3Q26/4Q26 EPS 分別為 4.38 元/6.04 元，
                         合計推估 2026 全年 EPS 為 15.12 元。


深化特殊材料布局，期待新專案           騰輝長期聚焦利基型特殊材料市場，並具備自行合成樹脂能力，除了掌握關鍵
驅動中長線成長                  配 方 外 ， 亦 可 降 低 原 料 成 本 。 PI 方 面 ， 截 至 3Q26 VT-901 產 品 營 收
                         +70~80%YOY，除了軍工需求倍增，亦有數家國際半導體設備大廠將 VT-901
                         用於半導體老化測試板，PI 產品毛利率約有 70%高水準；其他高毛利率產品如
                         不流膠 PP 營收亦有好表現，截至 3Q26 不流膠 PP 營收+50%YOY。另外，騰
                         輝為全球主要車燈散熱材料供應商，其散熱鋁基板 80%應用於汽車照明，近期
                         騰輝新增 8～9 個散熱專案，拓展至 AI 與高功率電源散熱應用，提供後續特殊
                         材料成長動能。高速材料方面，騰輝亦有送樣下一世代 AI 專案(碳氫 CCL 與
                         PTFE 皆有送樣)，期待成為 AI 終端客戶二供廠商。產能方面，目前稼動率水準
                         未達滿載以提供訂單彈性；泰國新廠今年 9 月開始試加工，初期由裁切等後段
                         製程開始，上膠機預計 1H27 進廠裝機，完整產線預計 2027 年到位，目前規劃
                         至少兩條產線，若全產能運行，預估可增加 10～15%產能，除支應既有客戶需
                         求外，亦為 2027 年新產品放量預留成長空間；此外，騰輝亦通過 15 億元昆山
                         擴建案，新產能亦預計於 2027 年展開貢獻。

1. 結論建議 <
● 4Q26 有望開始測試新均熱片產品 . 若測試順利將為明年帶來強勁成長動能 . 預估 4Q26 營收季增

● 封裝廠產線設置中 . 預計明年中完成並於季底開始⼤量封裝量產 . 若均熱片產品順利將於上半年⼤量
出貨 ｡
● TR Lid 趨勢無虞提供長期成長動能 . 上修⽬標價⾄ 9,400 元 . 基於 2027 年 EPS ､ 45 倍本益比評價 ｡


2. 重點分析 <
● TR Lid 可望開始⼩量出貨
根據調查 . 明年開始 Rubin Ultra 可能開始使⽤ TR Lid(aka removable lid). 客⼾為避免在量產期出現良
率或其他問題 . 因此預計在今年底要求健策⼩量出貨 TR Lid 並開始在封裝廠做測試 ｡ 我們認為 . TR Lid
提早測試意味著提早採⽤的可能 . 因此 4Q26-1Q27 測試的數據極為重要 . 若測試皆無異狀則可以為明年
營運動能帶來強勁成長 . 預估 4Q26 TR Lid 出貨可達數萬片 . ⼩幅貢獻營收 . 預估健策 4Q26 營收 103
億 ､ 季增 6% . ⽑利率 49.8% ､ 季增 0.1 個百分點 . EPS 23.9 元 ､ 季增 6% . 上修 13% ｡
● TR Lid 明年有機會成為主流產品
根據調查 . TR Lid 的熱加壓需要對 Ring 及 Lid 分別進⾏⼀次 . 因此使⽤的設備會不同 . 並由兩家不同的
設備廠提供 . 產線預計明年中完成 . 屆時封裝廠可以應對客⼾需求提升 TR Lid 採⽤度 ｡ 我們原先預期 TR
Lid 要⾄少到 Rubin Ultra 才能使⽤ . ⽬前看來有機會提前⾄ Rubin 採⽤ . 如前⾯所述 . 測試結果決定⼀
切 . 但預計測試問題不⼤ ｡ 考慮 TR Lid 單價較現在的版本⾼出數倍 . 預估健策 2027 年營收 794 億元 ､
年增 143% . ⽑利率 52.8% ､ 年增 5 個百分點 . EPS 208.9 元 ､ 年增 192% . 上修 40% ｡
● ASIC 均熱片未來也將升級
我們認為隨著晶片熱功耗提升 . 屆時晶片的介質需要減少 . 因此未來晶片採⽤ TR Lid 的比重有機會增
加 . 為健策提供長期成長動能 . 並鞏固其龍頭地位 ｡ 考量到 TR Lid 狀況有可能優於預期 . 我們上修健策
2026/27 年獲利 8%/40% . 維持健策買進評等 . ⽬標價上修⾄ 9,400 元 . 基於 2027 年預估每股盈餘 ､
45 倍本益比評價 ｡

                四. 2026 年營運概況及展望
                觀察直得 2025 年營收 地 區，中國 大 陸 10~11%、台灣 11~12%、
                歐洲 33~34%、美國 21~22%、外銷其他地區 23~24%。直得營運
                主 體以 母 公 司(台 灣+外 銷 市場 )、 直 得 昆山 、 直 得 歐洲 、 直 得 美國
                為主。

                直得科技推出直驅式六自由度對位平台，整合全直驅架構、高動
                態響應與奈米級控制技術，旨在為先進光學組裝及主動對位應用
                提供高精度、高響應且具備高度彈性的解決方案。顯著降低傳統
                機械結構的背隙與摩擦，大幅提升運動控制的精準度與即時性，
                以 滿 足 CPO（ 共 同 封裝 光 學 ）、 PIC（ 光 子 積體 電 路 ）、 光 纖 陣 列
                及光學引 擎 等產業對 高 速、高精 度 對位作業 的 嚴苛要求 。

                該平台最核心的技術突破在於採用全直驅架構。相較於傳統依賴
                滾珠螺桿或皮帶等機械傳動的系統，全直驅架構直接透過線性馬
                達 驅 動 運 動 ， 能 有 效 消 除 機 械 結 構 中 的 背 隙 （ backlash） 與 摩 擦
                損耗。這不僅顯著提升了定位的精確度，更關鍵的是大幅縮短了
                運動過程中的延遲，增強了動態響應速度。對於需要快速且精確
                移動的光學元件或光纖耦合等應用而言，這種優勢直接轉化為更
                高的生產 效 率與良率 。

                                          壹、投 資 建 議
 投資建議：買進                  重 點摘 要：

 目標價位：1,205.00 元           2Q26 營 收符合 預期，毛利 率受 ABF 載 板、BT 載板 稼動 率提 升
        44.00X 2027 EPS     影 響， 毛利率 開始 轉佳， 也帶 動產品 組合 優化； 近日 景 碩 8 月
                            公 告之 單月自 結回 推， 3Q26 毛 利率高 於 30%。
 參考價位：962.00 元             AI 伺 服 器 帶 動 記 憶 體 產 業 需 求 增 長 ， 受 到 AI Server、 Storage
        35.08X 2027 EPS     需 求驅 動，記 憶體 模組以 及記 憶體 SSD Controller 相 關產 品需 求
        2026/09/24 收盤       熱 度方 興未艾 ， 及 2H26 起 光通 訊收 發模 組需求 量激 增，使 得
                            相 對應 的 BT 載板 需求增 加，景 碩 2026 年 BT 載板 營收 近 40%。
                           景 碩因 應客戶 需求 提升， 啟動 ABF 載板 產能擴 充， 景碩 ABF
                            載 板月 產能預 計將 自 2026 年 4,000 萬 片/月 ，提升 至 2027 年 的
                            5,000 萬 片/月，預 期 2027~2029 年 之間，ABF 載板 月產 能增幅 達
                            20~30%不等。


                          一. 2Q26 營收與財報優於市場預期，3Q26 毛利率續升
                          景 碩 2Q26 營 收 124.96 億 元，+12.53%QoQ，+30.66%YoY，毛 利 率
                          26.09%， 稅後 淨利 13.11 億元 ，稅後 EPS+2.49 元 。 2Q26 觀察 BT
                          載 板毛 利率受 惠於 稼動率 提升 至 75%已 開始 轉佳 ，ABF 載板 稼動
                          率 ，由 85%持 續往 上提升 至滿 載。展 望 3Q26，累 計 7~8 月份 營收
                          達 成率 約 65%(根 據近 日景 碩 8 月公告 之單 月自結 回推，3Q26 毛 利
                          率 高 於 30%)， 上調 景 碩 3Q26 營收至 143.43 億元 ，+14.78%QoQ，
                          +38.50%YoY， 預估 毛利率 增至 31.58%， 稅後 淨利+19.95 億元 ，單
                          季 稅後 EPS+ 3.79 元 。


                          二. 2H26 BT 載板受惠記憶體 SSD Controller 價格上漲
                          宏 遠投 顧觀察 ，BT 載板 在記 憶體陸 續回 溫之下 ，BT 載板 上會 於
                          記 憶體 產業成 長 Dram、NAND Flash 等 皆為 成長，記憶 體產業 能 見
                          度 近期 市況開 始轉 佳，其 中在 BT 載 板應 用端 Dram 佔 70%、NAND
                          Flash 佔 20%是 看正 向發展 ，DDR5 在 一般 型伺服 器與 車用之 滲 透
                          率 提升 趨勢會 相對 明確。BT 載板 方面，同 時受到 玻纖 用布 (E-Glass
                          與 少部 分 BT 載板用 T-Glass)缺 料影響，MGC、Hitachi Chemical 等
                          供 應商 產出減 少， 使 得 BT 載板 用玻纖 布缺 料 至 2027 年以 前都 偏
                          向 供需 緊俏； 此外 ，記憶 體產 業，受 到 AI Server、 Storage 等 需 求
                          驅 動，記憶體 模組 以及記 憶體 SSD Controller 相關 產品 需求熱 度 方

                興 未艾，也使 得相 對應的 BT 載板需 求增 加，景 碩的 記憶體 是對 應
                美 系大 客戶，為 反應 金價、 銅價 等原 物料 上漲行 情，平 均自 2H25
                起 BT 載 板報 價漲 幅 達 3~5%不 等(自 2026 年 起，BT 載板 針對 記憶
                體 客戶 可望調 整報 價達雙 位數 )，且延 續至 2H26 BT 載 板仍處 於 漲
                價 循環，預期 跟隨 記憶體 (涵蓋 DDR4、DDR5、DDR7、DDR8 等 產
                品 )需求 量激增 ，BT 載板啟 動正 向循環 至 2026 年底 甚至 2027 年 。
                針 對 2H26 至 2027 年光通 訊產 業，傳 統 Pluggable 結 構需求 量增，
                所 需 高 層 數 BT 載 板 上 面 承 載 DSP 跟 Light Engine(Transceiver)
                以 及 Switch ABF 載板，對 於景 碩而言，BT 載 板 需 求 量 因 而 增 加 。


                三. 景碩於 ABF 載板產能擴充，27~29 年為成長主軸
                ABF 載 板產業 於 2025 年起，AI 伺服器 相關 的載板 規格，A100(ABF
                面 積為 55mm*55mm)、H100(ABF 面積 為 65mm*65mm)面積放 大，
                層 數則 為 10~20L 之 間不超 過 20L 為主，儘 管高階 ABF 需求受 惠 於
                AI(包 含新 增的 NV AI 晶片 )、HPC 等， 可望 促使 ABF 產 業重回 供
                需 相對 平衡的 週期。2026 年 ABF 載板 展望，除了 傳統 NVDA 系 列
                顯 卡需 求之外，景 碩之 ABF 載板 業已打 入 AI ASIC ABF 載 板市 場，
                包 含 Google、Broadcom、 Meta、AWS 等 AI ASIC， 其中 ABF 載 板
                多 數 配 比 為 日 廠 ， 而 台 廠 欣 興 (Google、 AWS)、 南 電 (Broadcom、
                AWS、 Meta)、 景 碩 (Google 與 其他 客戶 訂 單 外 溢效 果 )多 已 通過 認
                證。展 望 2027 年，景碩持 續受 惠於 AI 與 HPC 帶動 高階 ABF 載 板
                需 求成 長，景 碩啟 動 ABF 載板 新增產 能擴 充，ABF 載 板月產 能預
                計 將自 2026 年 4,000 萬片/月，提升至 2027 年的 5,000 萬片/月，預
                計 2Q27 產能 到位，用於 滿足 NVIDIA Vera Rubin CPU 的 需求。ABF
                載 板產 能擴充 預計 將持續 至 2028~2029 年 ，預計 年增+30%YoY，
                2028 年 月產能 達 6,500 萬 片。預計年 增+20~25%YoY，2029 年 月產
                能 達到 8,000 萬 片/月 。


                四.預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 11.82/27.42 元
                2026 年 景碩營 運重 點在於，營 運動能 來自 於一般 型伺 服器 CPU 廠
                商 Intel、 AMD 均 有 新 品 帶 動 新 平 台 升 級 與 相 關 供 應 的 零 組 件 商
                機 ，及 景碩攻 入 AI 伺 服器 與 ASIC ABF 載板 。此外 ，受 惠於延 續
                至 2H26 BT 載 板仍 處於漲 價循 環，預 期跟 隨記憶 體需 求量、 光 通
                訊 收 發 模 組 需 求 量 激 增 。 因 而 ， 展 望 2026 年 ， 預 估 景 碩 營 收 為
                538.37 億 元，+36.81%YoY，毛 利 率 28.47%， 稅後淨 利 為 62.26 億
                元，稅後 EPS+11.82 元。展 望 2027 年，在 ABF 載板 月產 能持續 擴
                充 之下，BT 載 板價 漲，預 估景 碩營收 為 791.77 億 元，+47.07%YoY，
                毛 利率 為 33.19%，稅 後淨 利為 144.46 億 元， 稅後 EPS+27.42 元 。

                二.2026~2027 年營運概況及展望
                1.景碩 受惠 ABF 產 業供需 吃緊 ，未來 將提 升產品 技術 與規格
                依據載板廠商與半導體業界指出，日後將追隨半導體廠發展異質
                整 合封 裝、AiP(Antenna in Package)、Info-on-Substrate(InFO-oS)設 計
                或先進封裝的型式發展，欣興發展半導體級異質整合封裝，未來
                對 於欣 興 ABF 載板 的層數 、面 積向上 提升 至另一 個技 術層次 。 此
                外，Apple 自製 其 MacBook CPU 所採用 之載 板與封 裝集 成設計，Intel
                之 外，AMD 也 同步 發表其 Chiplet 概 念，用 於 Server CPU 平 台 中 ，
                包 含 AMD EPYC Zen II 與 Gen 3rd Ryzen CPU，新 型 CPU 用到 台積
                電 7nm 製程性 能提 升 15%以 上，主 要用 於整 合 Dram 與其 他 I/O 介
                面，將 Chiplet 更 微縮，Chiplet 小晶 片技 術將 一個晶 片組 成的處 理
                器劃分為多個晶片，例如分別是：數據存儲、計算、信號處理、
                數 據流 管理等 功能，然後 再將 它們連 接在 一起形 成一 個「小 晶片 」
                的晶片網絡。也就是說，未來的電腦系統結構，可能只包含一個
                CPU 晶 片和幾 個 GPU，而 這些 GPU 都 連接 到這些 Chiplet 晶片 上，
                形成晶片網絡。換言之，未來計算機的系統結構，可能不是由單
                獨 封裝 的晶片 製造 的，而 是由 IC 製造 在一 塊較大 的矽 片上並 產 生

Equity Research
 Company Report｜Technology｜Sep 25, 2026


 Bizlink (3665 TT)
                                                                                                            Maintained     Buy
 Recent Developments Earnings Accretive                                                                     Target price   NT$ 3,333


 Joint development with ams OSRAM: On Sept 21, BizLink announced a joint development
 with ams OSRAM to co‑develop next‑generation optical interconnect solutions for scale‑up
 architectures. The collaboration focuses on a microVCSEL‑based *“wide‑and‑slow”optical
 link. It offers low cost, supply‑chain readiness, and easy co‑packaging, targeting short‑reach,
 power‑sensitive scale‑up links. Their “wide‑and‑slow” architecture can aggregate many lanes
 to achieve high bandwidth, and at the same time avoid the InP substrate constraints. OSRAM
 will supply the microVCSEL light sources, while BizLink will handle fiber‑connector design and
 assembly. It is in the R&D stage, with potential ramp in 2H27.

 Interplex a meaningful contribution to earnings and positioning: Interplex’s Sep 23
 consolidation provides an uplift to BizLink’s earnings trajectory and strengthens its
 AI‑datacenter positioning. We estimate Interplex’s current monthly run‑rate at NT$1.4–1.5bn,
 suggesting robust sequential revenue growth in 3Q26 (+19% QoQ), 4Q26 (+20%), and 2027
 (+50%). We estimate Interplex to contribute ~11% of 2027 revenue, leading to total datacom
 exposure to 48%/56%/64% in 2026–2028. Strategically, the deal broadens BizLink’s AI‑server
 portfolio beyond its leadership in power whips, cabling, and busbars to include chassis and
 other mechanical components; our supply chain research indicates Interplex is a vendor for
 leading GPU platforms, reinforcing BizLink’s competitive position.

 AEC is set to re‑accelerate while power remains intact: AEC pull‑in demand has begun to
 materialize, and we expect Credo (CRDO Buy)’s momentum to accelerate starting CY3Q26
 thanks to 800G AEC for T3, which will stay as maintain product of AWS till end-2027. We also
 expect the company to benefit from the strong Neocloud build‑outs, particularly SpaceX.
 Meanwhile, the HVDC roadmap remains unchanged, with 800V/660kW starting in 4Q26 and
 volume ramping in 2H27 alongside broader NVL576 adoption. Based on our supply chain
 research, we see robust build plan of 800V HVDC side-car in 2027. We note that the power
 whip content per rack to be doubled if a HVDC pairs with 2 VR200 NVL72 racks.

 Maintain buy and raise TP to NT$3,333: We continue to expect tailwinds for its AEC, Power,
 optics and the acquisition of Interplex. By factoring in the Interplex consolidation, stronger AEC
 and higher share counts, we revise EPS estimates by +6%/+14% in 2026E/2027E and lift TP
 from NT$3,140 to NT$3,333, now based on 26x 2027E EPS.

 Risks: 1) AI demand slowdown, 2) technology risk, 3) optical business delay, 4) competition.

                                                    Valuation and Recommendation

                                                    Maintain Buy with TP of $3,333

                                                    We rate Bizlink (3665 TT) Buy and set our TP at NT$3,333 which is based on 26x our 2027E EPS
                                                    estimate, or 18x 2028E EPS, and is lower than prior 28x given recent AI supply chain de-rating. We
                                                    adopt 2027 as valuation basis, as the market has looked beyond this year and to capture its robust
                                                    Power business potential with the ramp-up of optical. We adopt P/E methodology as we believe the
                                                    market mainly focuses on the company’s earnings outlook.

                                                    The Bizlink is the highest-quality cabling maker worldwide and is expected to start optical business in
                                                    later this year backed by the acquisition of Xin FuSheng, together with the expansion to higher-value
                                                    HPC components by acquisition of Interplex. We like the company as we view it as an AI connectivity
                                                    solution provider with increasing margin-accretive power business in 2026 and beyond. To further lift
                                                    valuation, the ramp-up curve and margin outlook will be critical.

                                                    The company traded at an average of 22x since 2021 and was on an average of 26x since 1Q24 when
                                                    the AI business. We derive our target price based on 26x P/E, which is inline with the mid-cycle level
                                                    given its fast-growing AI momentum. We note the company delivered 78%/82% YoY growth in EPS in

                                              Pegatron (4938.TW): AI servers in expansion; New smartphone model
                                              with Broadband entering peak season to support growth ahead; Sell

                                              3-month revenues preview: We expect sequential revenue growth in Sep-Dec,                                                                                                       Verena Jeng
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              +852-2978-1681 | verena.jeng@gs.com
                                              mainly driven by AI server racks ramp up with higher ASP and major smartphone                                                                                                   Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C.

                                              brand customer’s new model launches (report link). Overall, we project Pegatron’s                                                                                               Allen Chang
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              +852-2978-2930 |
                                              3Q/4Q26E revenues to grow +18%/+25% YoY, driven by: (1) new model launches                                                                                                      allen.k.chang@gs.com
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C.
                                              from a major smartphone customer supporting September and 4Q26 revenue
                                              growth; (2) a continuing ramp-up in AI server shipments, across rack-level and
                                              baseboard-based, riding on the growing demand in Neocloud and enterprises, (3)
                                              broadband, IoT, and game console entering peak season. We are positive on
                                              Pegatron’s expansion from consumer electronics to AI servers and automotive
                                              electronics, while the high memory costs could cap PC and smartphone market
                                              growth. Maintain Sell on stretched valuation.

                                              Pegatron’s Aug revenue was up 34% YoY / 3% MoM to NT$88bn, or 12% lower than
                                              our estimate. This reflects that high memory costs continue to cap PC and
                                              smartphone growth, despite a strong ramp-up in AI servers. Aug PC shipments was
                                              down 49% YoY to 0.40-0.45m, reflecting the impact of consumption pull in under
                                              the high memory costs. Its major smartphone brand customer launched new models
                                              in Sep, supporting Pegatron’s growth in Sep and 4Q26; prior to September, the
                                              company suffered from model transition (i.e. declining demand for older models
                                              while new models were in a slow shipment ramp-up phase).

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
                                              normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
                                              vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
                                              Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).

                        VSMC Opening- From Buildout to Growth
                        CITI'S TAKE

                        We attended VSMC's opening ceremony in Singapore on Sep 28th. The                    Buy
                        event marked the formal transition of the VIS–NXP Singapore joint                    Price (24 Sep 26 15:00)        NT$170.50
                        venture from construction since 2024 into an operating manufacturing                 Target price                  NT$185.00
                        platform, underscoring the strategic importance of the project for both              Expected share price return         8.5%
                        partners. NXP highlighted the fab as a key source of 300mm capacity for              Expected dividend yield             4.2%
                        automotive, industrial, mixed-signal, power management and edge-AI
                                                                                                             Expected total return              12.7%
                        applications, while VIS emphasized supply-chain resilience,
                        manufacturing excellence and long-term customer partnerships. TSMC                   Market Cap                  NT$320,285M
                        also plays a critical role in the JV through technology transfer, employee                                        US$10,096M
                        training and operational support, and is an important customer for silicon
                        interposer. The fab covers 130/90nm through 40nm-class specialty
                        technologies with Phase 1 capacity ultimately reaching ~44K WPM. With                Laura (Chia Yi) ChenAC
                        TSMC's comprehensive support, particularly in the interposer business,               +886-2-8726-9090
                        VSMC is moving from execution risk toward utilization, product-mix                   laura.cy.chen@citi.com
                        improvement and earnings contribution, with 2027 set to become the first
                        meaningful ramp year.                                                                Jack Chen
                                                                                                             +886-2-8726-9091
                                                                                                             jack1.chen@citi.com

                                                                                                             Nicholas Lai
                              • Strategic JV + Ecosystem Extension - VSMC is becoming more than a            +886-2-8726-9093
                                normal 12-inch mature-node fab. VSMC is a VIS–NXP JV, with NXP serving       nicholas.lai@citi.com
                                as the key long-term partner and anchor customer for automotive,
                                industrial, mixed-signal, power management and trusted edge/physical AI
                                applications. At the same time, TSMC will become a deeper strategic
                                partner: not only providing technology transfer, training and operational
                                support, but also acting as a key customer for silicon interposer.
                                Management expects to ramp up the capacity to 20kwpm by late 2027, out
                                of the total planned capacity of 44kwpm. Moreover, management expects
                                to achieve breakeven by the end of next year.

                              • Key Technology and Capacity: 130/90nm to 40nm. VSMC will support
                                130nm/90nm technology , with extension toward 40ULP, embedded Flash,
                                mixed-signal, power management, analog and potentially other specialty
                                platforms. On capacity, Phase 1 total capacity is now framed at around 44K
                                WPM, with 2027 ramp potentially reaching ~20K WPM, faster than the
                                original full-ramp schedule. Around 60% of capacity is covered by LTA;
                                more importantly, silicon interposer is fully transferred from TSMC, with
Prepared for Kevin Lu


                                demand essentially coming from TSMC, making this less of a merchant
                                foundry and more of a captive ecosystem-extension opportunity.

                              • AI-related revenue contribution expected to reach 25-30% in 2027.
                                Management previously guided AI revenue exposure to reach double-digit
                                in 2H26, but the latest messaging suggests AI exposure could rise toward


                        See Appendix A-1 for Analyst Certification, Important Disclosures and Research Analyst Affiliations
                         Vanguard International Semi. (5347.TWO)
                        28 September 2026                                                                                                                     Citi Research


                                25–30% including power management IC and interposer. The profitability mix is also likely to improve because
                                interposer is likely to be higher-margin than standard mature-node wafer revenue, while requiring limited
                                incremental CapEx since the technology and demand are transferred from TSMC. Therefore, although depreciation
                                will rise as VSMC enters production in 2027, margin pressure could be partly offset by higher utilization, LTA-backed
                                loading, pricing support, and richer interposer/AI power mix. In short, 2027 could become an earnings inflection year
                                for VSMC in Singapore rather than being burdened heavily by depreciation for VIS.

                        Vanguard International Semi.
                        Valuation
                        Our target price for VIS of NT$185 is based on 25x 2027E P/E, which we see as justified by its robust PMIC sales growth
                        momentum and increasing outflow order opportunity from TSMC with support from its consistent cash dividend policy. Our
                        target price equates to 2026/27E P/B of 3.6x/3.5x.


                        Risks
                        Key downside risks to our target price include: 1) weaker 8-inch demand along with higher costs due to inflation or more severe
                        ASP competition from Chinese peers; 2) lower UTR of the new capacity at the newly acquired fab, with depreciation burden;
                        and 3) less-than-expected outsourcing opportunities from IDMs.


                        NXP Semiconductors NV
                        (NXPI.O; US$238.08; 1; 25 Sep 26; 16:00)


                        Valuation
                        Our price target of $370 is based on a 17x P/E applied to CY28 EPS, given peer multiple expansion tied to rising data center
                        exposure.


                        Risks
                        End Market: NXP derives roughly 55% of sales from the automotive end market and roughly 18% of sales from the industrial
                        end market. Therefore, any major changes in auto sales or industrial activity could result in upside/downside to our estimates
                        and target price for NXP.

                        Competition: NXP competes with several companies in analog, digital, and microcontrollers. Consequently, any changes in
                        market share could result in upside/downside risk to our estimates and target price.

                        Inventory Risk: NXP sells roughly 50-60% of its products through distributors. As a result, we believe any major fluctuations of
                        inventory in the distribution channel could result in upside/downside risk to our estimates and target price.

                        Macroeconomic: NXP’s geographic exposure spans multiple geographies including the U.S., Europe, and Asia. As a result, any
                        prolonged macroeconomic strength/weakness could result in upside/downside to our estimates and target price.


                        TSMC
                        (2330.TW; NT$2475.0; 1; 24 Sep 26; 13:30)


                        Valuation
                        Our target price for TSMC shares of NT$3,800 is based on 25x the average of our 2027E EPS, higher than its three-year
                        average forward PER, versus global peers’ average of 15-23x. We believe our PER target is justified by TSMC's leading position
                        in advanced process node and robust AI demand growth outlook. Given its continuing leadership in the semiconductor
                        foundry industry, we believe TSMC’s stable order visibility and earnings outlook make it less vulnerable than peers to a
                        potential global economic downturn. Our target price equates to 2026E/27E P/E of 34x/25x and 2026E/27E P/B of 13x/10x.


                        Risks
Prepared for Kevin Lu


                        Key downside risks that could impede the shares from achieving our target price include: 1) weakness in the global
                        semiconductor market; 2) larger-than-expected margin contractions due to depreciation cost hikes and strong NTD; 3)
                        competitors entering the foundry business; 4) longer-than-expected digestion of inventory in the supply chain; and 5) a
                        slowdown in demand either from a global economic downturn or a global trade disruption triggered by tariffs.

                   1. Google TPU supply chain update

                   TSMC CoWoS may support both 3nm (Zebrafish) and 2nm (Humufish) MediaTek TPU
                   in 2028: In our earlier report, MediaTek: 2Q26 results preview: Smartphone weak, but
                   Cloud AI taking off; OW (26 Jul 2026), we noted that MediaTek may secure a portion of
                   CoWoS capacity for 2nm TPU to ensure minimum volume production. But, we believe it
                   will use EMIB-T from Intel (covered by Joseph Moore) as the primary solution to reduce
                   costs and scale volume in 2028, if execution proceeds well. Our recent industry checks
                   suggest TSMC CoWoS would continue to support both 3nm (Zebrafish) and 2nm
                   (Humufish) MediaTek TPU in 2028. We now assume around 500k units of 2nm TPU going
                   through CoWoS production as a second source. The 3nm TPU in 2028 of around 2mn
                   units is higher than our initial expectation of 1mn units. We therefore raise our MediaTek
                   2028 TPU revenue assumption to US$51.5bn.

                   2nm TPU TAM is supported by different SKU: At our AI Summit, MediaTek management
                   stated that its design service is capable of both training and inference design. Recently,
                   investors have been asking whether MediaTek is involved in the design of 2nm TriggerFish
                   TPU, intended for AI inference. Our supply chain checks suggest this could be true. The
                   TriggerFish chip has more features (I/O die upgrade, one more simulation die, and change
                   of HBM controller to HBM4e), so we think MediaTek’s 2nm TPU blended ASP could go
                   higher. We estimate ASP at US$12-20k (we now model US$13k). But again, the EMIB-T
                   substrate yield should be the key risk to volume.

                   CoWoS constraint eased, but ABF substrate supply still the gating factor for TPU bull
                   case: In our recent AI supply chain tracker, we noted that MediaTek’s 180k CoWoS-S
                   booking implies ~3.6mn units of TPU 8t (ZebraFish) in 2027, above our original 3mn
                   shipment assumption. However, we continue to bake in some conservatism as we had
                   assumed ABF substrate shortages. So, we still forecast 3mn units in 2027.

    3. Why TSMC is motivated to support MediaTek and Google?

    TSMC's CoWoS-L solution carries a structurally higher cost due to its larger reticle size, as
    we discussed in The Foundry Floorplan: TSMC preview update; CoWoS vs. EMIB
    competition (14 Apr 2026). We believe TSMC also wants to address growing competition
    from Intel's EMIB-T, which we estimate will reach 40-45k wafer equivalent capacity 2028,
    implying a 10-15% share of the 2.5D packaging market.

    For MediaTek to adopt TSMC's CoWoS-L as a second source alongside EMIB-T, the RDL
    (redistribution layer) connection to the interposer requires tape-out of three additional
    photomask layers. However, our checks suggest that Google is willing to absorb the
    incremental costs associated with dual sourcing, which should allow MediaTek to sustain
    its gross margin.

                                              Neutral

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
                                              normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
                                              vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
                                              Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).

                                              M&A Rank
                                              Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary
                                              across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring
                                              companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2
                                              representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard
                                              departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not
                                              factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The

                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).

智邦 2345 TT（電子-通信網路）

買進－維持買進

目標價：2,380.0 元　+25.6%
收盤價：1,895.0 元

不畏風雨、小鷹高躍

投資與評價

1. 智邦 2Q26 在 800G 產品強勁需求推動下，營運優於預期；因 AI 加速器與高階網路交換器拉貨需求仍處產業旺季，3Q26 營運續創新高。

2. 受惠資料中心高階產品規格升級趨勢，4Q26 網路交換器需求成長相隨，AI 應用增加美系客戶陸續更新高階算力加速器，網路交換器升級加快，智邦 26 年 EPS 85.18 元與 27 年預估 EPS 107.53 元，營運續創歷史新高。

3. 目前智邦股價 1,895.0 元，約為 17.6X 27(F)PER，低於近三年參考本益比區間 14~35X 中間偏下位置，考量資料中心需求快速成長與高階產品滲透增加，26 年與 27 年營運可望接續創高，維持買進投資評等，由於營運旺季將過，且受零組件漲價影響與 AI 加速卡產品營收快速增加，使 2H26 毛利率略低於 1H26 水準，故將本益比評價略微調降至中間偏下約 22 倍位置，目標價 2,380 元(22X 修正後 27(F)PER)。

重點更新

智邦 2Q26 進入產業旺季，營運為歷史單季新高

智邦因進入傳統旺季與工作天數回升，資料中心客戶加速拉貨 800G 高階網路交換器產品，再加上新一代 AI 加速卡產品也於季中正式量產，自 4 月與 5 月營收創新高，6 月營收更是大幅躍升，2Q26 整體營收為 955.38 億元(+36.2% QoQ)，高於預估 7.1%，因高階網路交換器佔比自 1Q26 起已提高，毛利率 19.7%略高於上季，由於新產品開發與產能擴充所需，營業費用 44.91 億元(+23.0% QoQ)，略高於預估，營業淨利仍可季增 42.6%至 143.31 億元，優於預期，稅後淨利 110.53 億元(+32.5% QoQ)，EPS 19.78 元，營運為歷史新高。

預期智邦 3Q26 仍處產業旺季，營運將再創新高

智邦 3Q26 仍處傳統旺季，美系資料中心客戶加速拉貨 800G 高階網路交換器產品，新一代 AI 加速卡產品也於本季完整放量出貨，7 月營收雖與 6 月持平，仍為歷史次高水準，8 月營收再創歷史新高，首次站上四百億元大關，預期美系客戶對於 AI 加速卡需求依然強勁，故上修整體營收預估 61.4%至 1,219.21 億元(+27.6% QoQ)。受產品組合轉變與部分零組件漲價影響，略微調低毛利率預估至 18.1%，但也因營收規模擴張，使營業費用率下降至 3.9%，故調升營業淨利預估 62.4%至 173.36 億元(+21.0% QoQ)，稅後淨利 133.65 億元(+20.9% QoQ)，EPS 23.91 元，營運再創新高。

需求推動漲價，傳輸靠PTFE解方


 福邦投顧 研究部
   2026/10
 26Q4結論-上游材料加速更新，漲價仍為主旋律
1.PCB上游:供不應求推動漲價動力，新材料應用下帶來新機會
•   玻纖布:E-Glass(高階)/LowDK-2/T-Glass 在2026Q4~2027年呈現全面緊缺，成為推動當前上游材
    料漲價的主要因素，也是決定結構性缺貨的關鍵原料。
•   銅箔:HVLP4加速驗證日台以外的供應商，中系擴產積極，維持2027年供需缺口放緩預期。
•   銅箔基板:PTFE樹脂為美系客戶解決互聯的確定性解方，成為銅箔基板材料中新晉路線；傳統的
    PPO/CH樹脂仍有一片天，26Q4 VR300 設計將定案，PTFE+M8/M9設計呼聲較高。
•   鑽針:高階鍍膜針需求攀升，供應商在2026~2028年加快投入建置產能，新材料(PTFE)仍有一定的
    鑽針消耗，產品組合的改變遠比漲價來的重要。

2. IC載板: 產能全數售罄，缺料與缺產能並行，關注供應商漲價態度。
•   供需缺口:維持2026/2027年 20%+/40%+ 缺口預期。
•   主邏輯為面積放大+層數增加，大廠產能售罄，客戶需要付出更高的價格預定產能+料源。

3. PCB:關注AWS、Google新品放量，以及2027~2028年HDI設計的變化，聚焦Tier1供應體
系。

• 下個世代的半導體封裝需要更大的面積來放置更多元件、支持2D~3D封裝(CoWoS~SOIC)

  。

  層或不均勻的厚度，會導致內埋元件的損壞，因此之後許多載板核心的設計會採用厚
  Core+ low CTE 膠片（採用T/Q Glass)。
